writeup: TIC 229832383 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 6.1268 days. The system shows a primary eclipse causing a 2.20% dimming of light, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 97.6 in the automated transit search. Pixel-level analysis confirms the signal at the target location with a peak signal-to-noise of 25.9, though the centroid offset of 1.9 arcsec warrants further study. No secondary eclipse was detected. The star does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a new candidate for follow-up observations. The pipeline's machine-learning classifier assigned it a score of 0.48, indicating moderate confidence that this represents a genuine eclipsing binary rather than a false positive.
